description: Private web task manager for two people, with a deliberately public read-only AI endpoint for task planning. The browser app itself requires Google sign-in. Writes are not public.

when_to_use: When the user asks to check, review, summarize, prioritize, plan, or catch up on their Lyfe tasks.
When the user asks what is overdue, due today, or due through a future date in Lyfe.
ai_usage.owner_selection: Use owner=Sebo for Sebastian/Sebo and owner=Alomi for Alomi. If the current user's identity is not clear from the conversation or saved context, ask which person before fetching. Never guess between Sebo and Alomi.
ai_usage.shared_tasks: Tasks owned by All are automatically included in either person's results.
ai_usage.planning_guidance: For catch-up planning, fetch through today unless the user asks about a future horizon. Use daysOverdue, frequency, task type, and due date to prioritize. Do not treat a very overdue repeating task as requiring multiple completions; it represents one currently outstanding recurrence.
ai_usage.cost_guidance: Make one read request per user question when possible. Do not poll or repeatedly refetch to verify the same answer.

owner.description: Whose tasks to read. Shared All tasks are included automatically.

through.description: Return active tasks due on or before this inclusive date.

public_read_api.privacy: This endpoint is intentionally public and read-only. It exposes only task-planning fields. It does not expose emails, Firebase document IDs, notification tokens, authentication data, or stats.

private_write_api.description: Add and modify operations require a private per-person API key. Delete is intentionally not exposed by the API.
